excerpt: Resource VFS initialized; entering original engine
runtime_log.note: The md=[61] NullPointerException is caught by the original engine and Run continues; it is not the native process-ending crash in these dumps.

save_bin.interpretation: initial save data was produced before the native abort; exact gameplay semantics remain to be validated

root_cause.details: The SceKernel-created DBTB audio worker enters dbtb_mixAudio, which used std::mutex/std::lock_guard backed by pthread/libstdc++. The lock path raises std::system_error on hardware; with the native adapter compiled -fno-exceptions this reaches terminate/abort and kill(SIGABRT), whose unsupported VitaSDK _kill_r path intentionally executes UDF #255.

fix.strategy: remove std::mutex from the Vita audio worker and use a no-throw std::atomic_flag guard shared by the main and SceKernel audio threads; retain pthread linkage only for other runtime facilities
